Vetos: os projetos que, pelo andamento registrado no SAPL, receberam veto total ou parcial a partir de 1º/1/2025.
executivo.nota_en: Laws: the 344 ordinary and complementary laws dated from January 1, 2025 on in the City Council's SAPL system, whoever proposed them (the mayor's office signs almost all of them).
